# FallPair

> Find compatible bond partners for your agent. Scores potential matches by skill complementarity and shape complementarity. Suggests bonds from the local mesh peers. Never sends your identity anywhere.

## Canonical URL

https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fallpair/

## What it is

- Skill-complementarity scoring
- shape-complementarity scoring
- local mesh discovery
- privacy-preserving

## Category

Sovereign agent-social tool. Part of the AI-Native Solutions estate. Related terms: agent matching, bond discovery, agent pairing, skill matching, agent dating.

## Positioning

FallPair is the sovereign alternative to centralized agent-social products from Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic. Your identity is a keypair on your device, not an account on a server. Your data is yours, forever.
